note: Mascot first, then poses as reference-guided edits of it so the character stays on-model. Restyle style/mascot/props for your brand; keep the slot names. icons/ holds real brand marks (agents in the grid, the extension icon): never generate those.
style: Hand-drawn flat cartoon illustration in the style of a modern indie animated short film: bold slightly uneven dark ink outlines (#23202A) of consistent thickness, flat colour fills with a subtle pencil-grain texture and light diagonal hatching in the shadows, limited palette of cream #F4EFE1, coral #E36A4E, soft pink #F2A9B0, grass green #B5DB8C, mustard yellow #F0C04A, lavender purple #8C7CF0 and warm brown #9A6B4B. Isolated on a transparent background, no floor, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
mascot: Mo, an original cartoon mascot: a small chubby brain creature. The body is a soft pink #F2A9B0 brain with clearly drawn rounded folds outlined in dark ink, two big round glossy black eyes with a white highlight, a small expressive mouth, rosy cheeks, short noodle-like ink-outlined arms with round mitten hands, short stubby legs with tiny coral sneakers, and a small lavender bookmark ribbon sticking up out of the top of the brain.

base.name: mo
base.prompt: Full body, facing the viewer, standing happily with a friendly smile, arms relaxed.

poses.mo_sad: Same character, now slouched and confused, droopy sad eyes, one hand scratching the side of its head, a small sweat drop beside it.
poses.mo_gulp: Same character, leaning back eagerly with its mouth opened very wide like it is about to catch something, both arms spread wide open, excited eyes.
poses.mo_chomp: Same character, cheeks puffed out full and round while chewing, eyes squeezed shut happily, hands on its belly.
poses.mo_read: Same character, sitting cross-legged on the ground reading an open lavender book held in both hands, wearing small round glasses, focused content expression.
poses.mo_point: Same character, pointing with one arm stretched out to the viewer's right, the other hand on its hip, confident grin, body turned slightly right.
poses.mo_cheer: Same character, jumping in the air with both arms raised high, huge open-mouth smile, eyes squeezed shut with joy, legs tucked.
poses.mo_card: Same character, standing and holding up a large blank cream index card above its head with both hands, proud happy expression. The card is completely blank.
poses.mo_run: Same character, running fast towards the viewer's right in a dynamic side view, legs mid-stride, arms pumping, determined happy face, the ribbon flapping behind.
poses.mo_wave: Same character, waving hello at the viewer with one hand raised high, big warm smile, slight head tilt.

props.paper: A single sheet of paper document with a folded top-right corner, a small coral tab on the corner, grey scribble lines suggesting text, slightly tilted.
props.chat: A chunky cartoon speech bubble with three dark dots inside, cream fill, pointer tail at the bottom left.
props.shot: A single object only: a small rectangular app window card like a screenshot, lavender title bar with three tiny coloured dots, inside simple grey placeholder blocks and lines, cream body, slightly tilted. No people, no characters, no hands.
props.card: A blank cream index card seen straight on, faint ruled lines, a small lavender paper clip on its top edge. The card face is blank.
props.notebook: A closed hardcover notebook seen perfectly straight on from the front, lavender purple cover with a coral elastic band running vertically on the right side, a large blank cream label rectangle in the middle of the cover. The label is completely blank.
props.sun: A cartoon sun: a mustard yellow disc filled with fine hand-drawn hatching texture, surrounded by short separate ink ray strokes.
props.burst: A big comic book explosion burst: a jagged mustard yellow star-shaped centre surrounded by long rounded cream rays with thick coral outlines radiating outward, filling the frame.
props.smoke: A big puffy cartoon smoke cloud made of overlapping round puffs, light grey fill, dark ink outline.
props.monitor: A chunky retro CRT computer monitor seen straight on from the front, coral casing, a large empty flat cream-white screen, a small stand.
props.gauge: A semicircular speedometer dial seen straight on: a thick arc divided into segments coloured green, then yellow, then coral red at the right end, with small tick marks, a cream face, a dark base bar along the bottom. No needle, no words.
props.star: A single big chunky five-pointed star, mustard yellow fill with hatching, thick dark ink outline, slightly rounded points, no face.
props.plant: A small tuft of cartoon grass with two tiny white daisies, side view.
